title: Watts in the overlay
line: Shows real CPU watts in the performance overlay. Any program can then read the power counter.
symptom: The performance overlay shows 0.0 W for the CPU on Intel handhelds: the RAPL energy counter it reads is root-only since 2020.
why: Every Intel chip's RAPL package counter (intel-rapl:0, intel-rapl-mmio:0) is mode 0400 since Linux closed the PLATYPUS power side channel (CVE-2020-8694).
risk_note: Reopens what the kernel closed on purpose: any local program can sample the chip's power counter (a side channel). Off by default for that reason.

changes.detail: systemd-tmpfiles makes the package energy counters 0444 at every boot, before Game Mode starts.
Mode 0444 at once; the old mode is saved and put back on undo.

undo: Deletes the tmpfiles rule and puts each counter's saved mode back (0400).
sources: ClawDeck py_modules/clawdeck/telemetry.py and docs/HARDWARE-FINDINGS.md (measured on a Claw 8 EX)

probe.what: Looks for a tmpfiles rule from the system (not GameCove's) that opens the counters, or the counters already being readable by everyone without GameCove.

watch.note: The RAPL powercap driver: a change to energy_uj's mode would make the rule unnecessary.
